title: Business - US payroll data shows young workers' jobs most affected by artificial intelligence
key_facts: In August, US employment in roles most exposed to AI for people aged 22 to 25 shrank by 4.4 percent year-on-year.
This means a contraction every month since October 2023, about a year after ChatGPT was first released.
The finding is a key trend from the Canaries Dashboard, a project led by the Stanford Digital Economy Lab and ADP Research.
France 24 spoke to ADP Research's Chief Economist Nela Richardson.
quote_evidence: In August, US employment in roles most exposed to AI for people aged between 22 and 25 shrank by 4.4 percent year-on-year.
The high impact of AI on younger workers is one of the key trends emerging from the Canaries Dashboard, a project led by the Stanford Digital Economy Lab and ADP Research.
why_it_matters_hint: Payroll data point to young workers in AI-exposed jobs being hit first.
